description: ACA Health Insurance Marketplace (HealthCare.gov) overview for a US ZIP code from CMS's QHP Landscape data: number of plans and insurers, plans per metal level, the cheapest plan of each metal level and the benchmark silver plan (second-lowest-cost silver, which sets ACA subsidies) with monthly premium before subsidies for the nearest published age, deductible and out-of-pocket maximum. Federal-platform states only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

age.description: Applicant age 0-120 (default 40); premiums are published for 0-14, 18, 21, 27, 30, 40, 50 and 60

county.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS when the ZIP spans several counties

year.description: Plan year (only the year CMS publishes now)

name: health_health_insurance_exchange
title: Health Health Insurance Exchange
